statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, G45.9, and Z86.73
The denial reason code is CO-197
The service was denied because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
